options.text: Spooky Mansion: An Adventure for Boys

text: You are a T-Rex, undisputed King of the Dinosaurs! You are out stomping when you see a log cabin!
author: ryan

text:
As you walk up to the cabin, you notice there are other dinosaurs here.  Nearby, there is a small Dromiceiomimus, watching.  Off in the distance you see what looks like a large Utahraptor.  Utahraptors were the natural enemies of your species. 

A meeting might lead to conflict.

options.text: I'm going to try my luck in an encounter with the Utahraptor!
I think it's better to play it safe.

author: ryan

text: As you approach, you realize that the Utahraptor is friendly!  The two of you begin a conversation.  Things are going well until he starts to point out flaws in your philosophical beliefs!

options.text: No matter, I'll shout something clever after him.

author: ryan

text:
Before you can say anything, a giant meteor strikes the earth! The impact wipes out 65% of all life, including your own.

Better luck next time!
author: ryan

text: You try to run away, but the Utahraptor chases after you! Luckily, you end up becoming friends and live happily ever after.
author: ryan

text: You try to run away, but the Utahraptor chases after you!  Luckily, you end up becoming friends and live happily ever after.
author: ryan

text:
You feel a little disoriented, as if by choosing not to walk towards the log cabin, you are breaking some sort of unwritten law.  You go out exploring.

After some walking, you get tired and lie down for a bit.  You wake up:
author: ryan

text:
Just as you are waking up, you have an odd sensation, as if you had a choice to wake up dead or not to wake up dead, and you chose poorly.

Before you can consider this too carefully, however, you wake up dead.
author: ryan

text: The dog that sang songs was the happiest dog in the world!
author: ryan

text:
You wake up in bed.  It is a beautiful new day!

Do you want to:
author: ryan

text:
As you stare at the ceiling, patterns in the stucco seem to emerge. 

You seem to be staring into an image of your own face! But something's different:

options.text: There's more lines, more sadness in the image.  It's you, but aged something like 30 years!
Your features are changed, youthened.  You look not a day over eight!

author: ryan
